tagline: Global renewable energy developer and independent power producer
hero_kpi_rationale: Exceptional revenue growth (46% YoY in 2025) and rapid installed capacity expansion (+22.8% YoY), supported by the commissioning of utility-scale projects in Europe and the United States, demonstrating successful execution of the business model.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue from electricity sales across all operational renewable energy projects.
kpis.description: Revenue is growing strongly, driven by increased operational capacity, particularly in the United States where PPA prices are rising significantly.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth driven by new operational projects and higher electricity prices in the U.S.

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from operations before taxes and interest expenses.
kpis.description: Operating profit is increasing strongly due to revenue growth and improved operating margin.
kpis.signal: Strong operational leverage and improved project returns

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit remaining after all expenses, taxes and interest are paid.
kpis.description: Net profit is nearly doubling year-over-year, reflecting increasing profitability and effective management of the financing structure.
kpis.signal: Exceptional profit growth and improved financial performance

kpis.name: Installed Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total electric generation capacity of all operational and under-construction renewable energy projects.
kpis.description: Installed capacity is expanding strongly, driven by completed projects and those in final construction phases in Europe and the United States.
kpis.signal: Rapid expansion of renewable energy generation platform

kpis.name: Electricity Generation
kpis.explanation: Total amount of electricity produced by all operational renewable energy projects.
kpis.description: Electricity generation is increasing strongly thanks to the commissioning of new projects, particularly in Europe and the United States.
kpis.signal: Strong generation growth aligned with capacity expansion

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.63 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €5.12 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the past four years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of €0.53 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Revenue Share Under PPA Contracts
kpis.explanation: Percentage of electricity revenue generated through long-term PPAs vs. merchant market sales.
kpis.description: The share of revenue from long-term PPAs increased to 80% in 2025 (vs 75% in 2024), strengthening the stability and predictability of cash flows.
kpis.signal: Increasing revenue stability through long-term PPA contracts

kpis.name: U.S. Revenue Contribution
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total electricity revenue generated from U.S. operations.
kpis.description: U.S. revenue contribution increased from 2% in 2024 to 26% in 2025, reflecting successful operational entry into the U.S. market with attractive PPA contracts.
kpis.signal: Significant geographic diversification into U.S. market with higher PPA prices

kpis.name: U.S. Solar PPA Prices
kpis.explanation: Average price received for electricity under long-term PPAs in the U.S. solar market.
kpis.description: U.S. solar PPA prices have increased 99% since early 2021, driven by increased electricity demand from data centers and progressive electrification.
kpis.signal: Favorable pricing environment driven by strong electricity demand and data center expansion

risks.title: Uncertainty in financial estimates
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of the document with strong language ('materially differ', 'unpredictable impact'). Capital category heavily weighted. Trend stable but structural in nature of development projects. Directly impacts reliability of EBITDA and cash flow forecasts.

risks.title: Multi-currency foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in the middle of the document with explicit exposure to EUR, NIS and USD. Neutral language but data shows volatility (EUR: 1.07-1.17, NIS: 0.27-0.30). Trend stable but structural. Geographically diversified portfolio (United States, Europe, Israel, MENA) amplifies exposure.

risks.title: Dependence on U.S. tax credits
risks.score_rationale: Major risk for U.S. portfolio (73% of total). Technical but critical language: IRA tax credits (PTC, ITC) are fundamental to valuation. Trend new/increasing with explicit references to IRA adjustments. Regulation category heavily weighted. Legislative changes could drastically reduce returns.

risks.title: Project construction financing risk
risks.score_rationale: Massive portfolio under construction (3.9 GW) and pre-construction (8.1 GW) requires substantial financing. Implicit but critical language: 'required equity during construction estimated at 10%'. Trend increasing with rapid pipeline expansion. Capital category existential for growth.

risks.title: PPA contract signature risk
risks.score_rationale: Several major projects without signed PPAs ('PPA to be signed'): Nardo (97 MW, 1.3 GWh), Tapolca BESS (140 MWh), Israel Storage (813 MWh), Yatir (38 MW). Neutral language but absence of contracts is critical commercial risk. Trend stable but structural to pipeline. Impacts bankability.

risks.title: Geographic concentration and political risks
risks.score_rationale: Portfolio exposed to Israel (mature and development), MENA (Iftach), Eastern Europe (Serbia, Croatia, Hungary, Kosovo). Neutral language but tense geopolitical context (Israel-Hamas, regional tensions). Trend increasing with MENA expansion. Geopolitical category weighted.

risks.title: Tax-equity partner risk
risks.score_rationale: Multiple projects with tax-equity partners (Atrisco PV/BESS: 17.5%-19% share, duration 5-10 years). Technical language but structural dependence. Trend stable but increasing with U.S. pipeline. Capital category weighted. Commercial terms variable ('subject to market conditions').

risks.title: Development pipeline execution risk
risks.score_rationale: Massive pipeline (19.3 GW total) with 11.2 GW in late-stage development. Neutral language but implicit execution risk. Trend increasing with rapid expansion. Industrial category weighted. Construction timelines, permitting, supply-chain are critical.

ai_positioning.summary: AI impact mentioned as a driver of electricity demand through data center expansion, but not positioned as a core operational lever for the company.
evidence: Reference to increased adoption of machine learning and AI driving electricity demand for data centers
U.S. PPA prices rising due to broader use of electricity in information technology sectors
No mention of AI-driven optimization for project operations, energy forecasting, or internal processes
